facts.text: The opera was first performed in the Hoftheater in Weimar on 23 December 1893, conducted by Richard Strauss.

facts.text: The libretto was written by Humperdinck's sister, Adelheid Wette, based on the Grimm brothers' fairy tale of the same name.
